name: 7SGaleri
author: durdagi

sections.description:
7SGaleri manages video, audio, and music platform content as separate WordPress posts.

Each item can have its own title, description, featured image, categories, tags, media source, and single-content page. The plugin is designed for video and audio publishing; it is not a photo gallery or a multi-item gallery field.

Main features:

  • Dedicated video and audio content type
  • YouTube, Vimeo, Spotify, Apple Music, SoundCloud, Deezer, Bandcamp, and local media support
  • Automatic 16:9 fallback covers for items without a featured image
  • Five-item featured area with two desktop layouts
  • Editorial mosaic layout on mobile devices
  • Live title search with a non-JavaScript fallback
  • Numbered pagination, load more, and infinite scroll
  • View counter and administration statistics
  • Social sharing tools
  • Related content
  • VideoObject and AudioObject structured data
  • ZIP import and export
  • Theme-width or custom-width layout options
  • Gallery-specific typography controls
  • Translation-ready English source strings for the WordPress translation platform

External Services

7SGaleri uses external services only for media selected by a site administrator and for optional sharing links selected by a visitor. The plugin author does not receive this data.

Embedded media players:

When a site administrator adds a supported media URL, 7SGaleri displays a player supplied by that service. The visitor’s browser connects to the selected service when the player is loaded. The service may receive the media URL or identifier, the visitor’s IP address, browser and device information, referrer information, cookies, and other data described in its policies. No player request is made when the administrator has not added content from that service.

  • YouTube and YouTube Music — used to display video or music players. Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy Terms: https://www.youtube.com/t/terms
  • Vimeo — used to display video players. Privacy: https://vimeo.com/privacy Terms: https://vimeo.com/terms
  • Spotify — used to display audio and music players. Privacy: https://www.spotify.com/legal/privacy-policy/ Terms: https://www.spotify.com/legal/end-user-agreement/
  • Apple Music — used to display music players. Privacy: https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/ Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/
  • SoundCloud — used to display audio players. Privacy: https://soundcloud.com/pages/privacy Terms: https://soundcloud.com/terms-of-use
  • Deezer — used to display audio and music players. Privacy: https://www.deezer.com/legal/personal-datas Terms: https://www.deezer.com/legal/cgu
  • Bandcamp — used to display audio and music players. Privacy: https://bandcamp.com/privacy Terms: https://bandcamp.com/terms_of_use

Direct external media files:

A site administrator may also enter a direct video or audio file URL, such as an MP4 or MP3 file hosted on another domain. When that content is viewed, the visitor’s browser connects directly to the administrator-selected host to request the media file. That host may receive the requested media URL, the visitor’s IP address, browser and device information, referrer information, cookies, and other data under its own terms and privacy policy. Because the host is selected by the site administrator, the site owner is responsible for disclosing and complying with that host’s applicable terms and privacy policy. No direct external media request is made unless an administrator has configured such a URL.

Optional social sharing:

Sharing links are generated locally. A visitor’s browser connects to the selected service only after the visitor clicks its sharing button. Depending on the selected service, the plugin passes the current content permalink and title; Pinterest may also receive the cover-image URL and a short description. The external service may process the visitor’s IP address, browser and device data, cookies, account information, and the shared values according to its own policies.

  • Facebook — Privacy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/ Terms: https://www.facebook.com/terms.php
  • X — Privacy: https://x.com/en/privacy Terms: https://x.com/en/tos
  • WhatsApp — Privacy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy Terms: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service
  • Telegram — Privacy: https://telegram.org/privacy Terms: https://telegram.org/tos
  • LinkedIn — Privacy: https://www.linkedin.com/legal/privacy-policy Terms: https://www.linkedin.com/legal/user-agreement
  • Reddit — Privacy: https://redditinc.com/policies/privacy-policy Terms: https://redditinc.com/policies/user-agreement
  • Pinterest — Privacy: https://policy.pinterest.com/en/privacy-policy Terms: https://policy.pinterest.com/terms-of-service

Privacy

7SGaleri does not send analytics or usage data to the plugin author.

To reduce duplicate view counts, the plugin stores a first-party cookie for up to 24 hours and a one-way salted fingerprint derived from the visitor’s IP address and browser user-agent string in a WordPress transient for up to six hours. Raw IP addresses and raw user-agent strings are not stored by the plugin.

Third-party embedded players may process visitor data according to the policies listed in the External Services section.
sections.installation:
1. Open Plugins > Add New Plugin in the WordPress administration area.
  2. Select Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the 7SGaleri ZIP package and install it.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Configure listing, featured area, permalink, typography, and appearance settings under 7SGaleri > Settings.
  6. Save the WordPress permalink settings once after changing the gallery permalink structure.
sections.faq:
Can I create photo galleries?

No. 7SGaleri is designed for video, audio, and music content.

Is a featured image required?

No. When no featured image is assigned, the plugin uses a 16:9 fallback cover that matches the content type.

How many items are shown in the featured area?

The featured area uses five items. Desktop layouts can display one primary item with four supporting items, or two primary items with three supporting items. Mobile devices use one full-width item followed by a 2-by-2 editorial mosaic.

Do search and pagination work without JavaScript?

Yes. Live interactions are enhanced with JavaScript, while standard search forms and pagination links remain available without it.

Which languages are available?

The plugin uses English source strings and is ready for community translations through translate.wordpress.org. WordPress downloads approved language packs separately according to the site language.

Does uninstalling the plugin delete my content?

No. Posts, taxonomies, view data, and media files are preserved. Plugin settings and temporary transfer data are removed.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Fixed front-end asset cache compatibility after the directory-safe prefix migration.
  • Added cache-busting asset versions and aligned all public selectors with the sg7g prefix.

1.0.0

  • Initial stable WordPress.org release.
  • Adopted the directory-safe sg7g prefix for declarations and stored data.
  • Added two desktop featured layouts and the mobile editorial mosaic.
  • Added menu, home-page, and search controls.
  • Added gallery-specific typography and administration settings.
  • Added three pagination modes, statistics, sharing, and ZIP import and export.
  • Added translation-ready English source strings for translate.wordpress.org.
  • Tested with YedinciSanat, Twenty Twenty, and Twenty Twenty-Four themes.
